carga.contexto: Active, closed or declined cases that count towards 2026.
carga.ayuda: Keep the original number and actual dates. Leave optional unknown data blank. The first episode starts on the acceptance date; add an episode for each reopening and keep the previous closure. Loading does not generate documents or assign new numbers. The case is marked for review. Real data may only be loaded in production after the data protection assessment, security review and backup restoration checks.
carga.formato: Each spreadsheet contains 1 to 100 cases from one team. CSV: UTF-8 text, separated by commas or semicolons. XLSX: one visible sheet without formulas, macros, hidden rows or external links. Use the headers in the downloadable sheet. Dates must be text in YYYY-MM-DD format and lists must be JSON. The download includes all 18 provisional columns and invented active, reopened, closed and declined cases when the team has an assigned municipality. Accepted cases also require an acceptance date, catalog municipality and centre, reference role, description, each child’s sex and episodes. The complete provisional format is in the system documentation.
carga.obligatorio: This information is required to review the load.
carga.error: We could not complete the request. Try again.
carga.error_opciones: We could not load the options. Try again.
carga.sin_equipo: No team is available for loading. Ask Administration to check your assignment.
carga.validando: Checking the data. The case has not been saved yet.
carga.antivirus: Scanning the spreadsheet for viruses and checking each row. No cases have been saved yet.
carga.guardando: Checking and saving the complete load.
carga.resultado_incierto: The connection was lost and we do not yet know whether the load was saved. Retrieve the result before preparing another load.
carga.lote_valido: Reviewed {cantidad} case files. None have been saved yet.
carga.lote_invalido: Some data needs checking in the spreadsheet with {cantidad} case files. None have been saved.
carga.consecuencia: Confirming saves all case files in the load with their historical dates and statuses. They will be marked for review.
carga.elegir_fichero: Choose the CSV or XLSX spreadsheet
carga.limite: Up to 10 MB and 100 case files from one team.
carga.descargar: Download a spreadsheet with invented data
carga.numero_desconocido: If the original number is unknown, leave it blank. No new number will be assigned.
carga.sin_guardar: Reviewing does not save data. You can then confirm the complete load.
carga.numero_formato: Enter the team, sequence and year: two digits per part, separated by hyphens.
carga.fichero_invalido: Choose a CSV or XLSX file containing data, up to 10 MB.
carga.hoja_causa: The referring service withdrew the request before intervention began.
carga.hoja_descripcion: The family requests support with daily routines and school attendance.
carga.hoja_reapertura: The family returns to the municipality and requests support again.
